task.description: Write test specs and test source files for ENV-01, ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05. All MUST requirements need integration tests against real PostgreSQL. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests.

result.summary: Integration tests for ENV-01 (TC-01..12), ENV-02 (TC-01..03), ENV-03 (TC-01..06), ENV-05 (TC-01..06). Wrote env02_test.zig, env03_test.zig, env05_test.zig. Fixed 3 pre-existing compile errors in env01_test.zig. Registered all 4 test files in tests/integration/main_test.zig and added test-integration-env step to build.zig. zig build exits 0.

issues.description: env01_test.zig had 3 pre-existing compile errors (broken anyerror cast pattern on error-union types). Fixed as part of this handoff to unblock compilation.

TC-ENV-02-03 (cross-schema qualified access) may pass with zero rows rather than a PostgreSQL error in the test environment, because the bpm DB user owns all schemas. This is an environment constraint, not a code defect. The test correctly fails if cross-schema data leaks.
